links.outcome: USMLE question accuracy of Llama models with vs without semantic clinical knowledge RAG
links.effect: SCAI RAG significantly improved 13B on Steps 1 and 3, 70B on Step 2, 405B on Step 3; 13B with RAG passed Step 3 (60.2%). 70B and 405B passed all steps with or without RAG.
links.quote: Significant improvements associated with SCAI RAG were found for the 13B model on Steps 1 and 3, the 70B model on Step 2, and the 405B parameter model on Step 3.

unlisted_practices: Injecting formally represented semantic clinical knowledge (knowledge graph/ontology-based reasoning) into LLMs via RAG

screen.practice: retrieval augmented generation grounding with semantic clinical knowledge
screen.reason: The study directly evaluates whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with semantic clinical knowledge to existing LLMs improves performance on USMLE exam questions compared to the native LLMs alone.
